Title: Azure Cosmos DB: New Asia and US regions, and increased account limits

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB has doubled the regions in which it is available. Azure Cosmos DB now supports provisioning accounts in the East Asia, Southeast Asia, and US East Azure regions (in addition to our existing US West, North Europe, and West Europe regions). Azure Cosmos DB has also increased the maximum document size from 256 KB to 512 KB. To learn more about the new regions and account limits, you can:

  • Read the blog announcement: Azure Cosmos DB – New Asia, US regions, and increased account limits
  • Review the new limits: Azure Cosmos DB limits and quotas

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
